resources.string: Deletion of %1$s could not be confirmed. %2$s
Another operation is using this recording. Wait for it to finish, then retry.
The recording metadata is unavailable. Refresh Library, then retry.
The recording no longer matches the selection. Refresh Library and select it again.
Selected recording identity could not be verified. Refresh Library and retry.
The audio could not be verified safely. Check storage access, refresh Library, then retry.
The deletion could not be saved safely. Check available app storage, then retry.
Storage is unavailable or could not remove the file. Reconnect the storage and check access, then retry.
Android did not allow removal. Retry Delete and approve the access request if shown.
Android could not open the access request. Return to Reverb and retry Delete.
The storage provider did not confirm removal. Check storage access and refresh Library before retrying.
The audio was removed, but Library cleanup is pending. Refresh Library to finish updating the list.
Android or the storage provider did not identify the deletion problem. Refresh Library and retry.
%1$d deleted; %2$d need retry; %3$d awaiting approval.
, and %1$d more
Busy: wait, then retry
Metadata unavailable: refresh Library
Selection no longer matches: reselect
Identity not verified: refresh Library and retry
Cannot verify audio: check storage access
Cannot save deletion: check free space
Storage unavailable: reconnect it
Access denied: retry and approve access
Access prompt unavailable: reopen Reverb
Provider did not confirm removal: refresh
Audio removed, list cleanup pending: refresh
Cause unspecified: refresh and retry
Storage full: free space
Storage is read-only: restore write access
